segments.title: 3 hidden phone features
segments.say: Three hidden phone features most people never find. Number one.

segments.title: Tap the back of your iPhone
segments.say: Your iPhone has a button on the back. You just can't see it.

segments.title: It's called Back Tap
segments.say: It's called Back Tap. Double or triple tap the back to run a shortcut.

segments.title: Pick what it does
segments.say: Pick an action, like screenshot, Control Center, or Magnifier.

segments.title: iOS 14 or later
segments.say: It works on iOS fourteen or later.

segments.title: Your keyboard is a trackpad
segments.say: Number two. Your iPhone keyboard is secretly a trackpad.

segments.title: Hold the space bar
segments.say: Touch and hold the space bar until the keyboard turns light gray.

segments.title: Now slide your finger
segments.say: Now slide your finger to move the cursor anywhere.

segments.title: No more tapping the typo
segments.say: No more stabbing at the exact letter to fix a typo.

segments.title: It's in Apple's own guide
segments.say: It's in Apple's own iPhone user guide.

segments.title: Stop WhatsApp spam calls
segments.say: Number three. WhatsApp has a setting that stops calls from strangers ringing your phone.

segments.title: Turn it on here
segments.say: Open WhatsApp settings, then Privacy, then Calls.

segments.title: Calls still show in your list
segments.say: Silenced calls won't ring, but they still show in your call list.

segments.title: Miss nothing important
segments.say: So you can still call back anyone you need.

segments.title: Quick recap
bullets: Back Tap: tap your iPhone's back
segments.say: Quick recap: Back Tap: tap your iPhone's back. Space bar = trackpad. WhatsApp: silence unknown callers.
